title: The stairs
goals: Climb to the top of the stairs.
Do it in fewer than 5 lines.
starting_code:
# Up, right, up, right: one line for each stretch of the way.
wizard.move_up(2)
hints: Count the tiles of each stretch before you write its line.
After going up, the wizard turns right: `move_right` with the number of tiles of that stretch.
intro: These stairs climb up and to the right, twice. Each stretch of the way is one line, with its number.
